plan.objective: Isolate current Serv/runtime effects from current-source overhead with the immutable historical CL14 source.
plan.single_scientific_change: None; operationally bound training to 100 steps and startup validation to one unchanged 12-image batch.
plan.fixed_contract: Historical CL14 model/data/loss/optimizer, batch 2, one A100, pose_adapt_ratio=0, ca_mixing_for_face=false, 2240/219217920 trainable contract.
plan.primary_metric: Median displayed seconds/iteration over warmed optimizer steps 21-100.
plan.decision_gate: If this reproduces about 2.19 seconds/iteration, optimize current-source defaults-off overhead; if it remains about 3.56, attribute the gap to current execution conditions and profile data/GPU time before code changes.
plan.risk: Operational speed control only; not a scientific quality run.

runtime.first_attempt_result: Failed before Comet creation because the initial immutable-source verifier included mutable outputs/ and hm_debug/ paths.
runtime.source_verification: 1108 immutable files verified; mutable outputs/ and hm_debug/ excluded
runtime.gpu: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, GPU-7f2c8a20-39a5-adbf-4c71-a5fbc8a63189, P0, 400 W power limit
runtime.training_result: Displayed run-rate was stable at 2.14-2.17 s/iteration from steps 21-99; median displayed rate 2.15 s/iteration.
runtime.conclusion: The historical CL14 source reproduces its old speed on a current Serv A100, so the current CL14 regression is source-pipeline overhead rather than the machine/runtime.
